title: Cornucopia's closing gala, Lions Bay blues and Anything Goes: your Sea to Sky weekend
description: What’s on in Whistler, Squamish, Pemberton, Lions Bay and Britannia Beach this weekend: Cornucopia’s closing weekend, live music, markets and theatre.
intro: What’s on in Whistler, Squamish, Pemberton, Lions Bay and Britannia Beach this weekend: Cornucopia’s closing weekend, live music, markets and theatre.

entries.name: Cornucopia Night Market: Legends & Next Generation
entries.blurb: Culinary legends meet the next generation at a lively night market of inventive dishes, exceptional pours, music and discovery.

entries.name: KHIVA + SUBSCURA
entries.blurb: An intimate night of bass music and performance art with Creek St, Ghost Orchid, Daega Sound and Siadic.

entries.name: Sip & Savour: Experience Italy at Fergie’s Café
entries.blurb: An Italian-inspired tasting evening at Fergie’s Café in the Squamish Valley.

entries.name: Fresh Cut Grass
entries.venue: Brackendale Art Gallery, 41950 Government Rd, Squamish
entries.blurb: Live music night at the Brackendale Art Gallery café and culture centre.

entries.name: Anything Goes: The Musical
entries.blurb: The Pemberton Arts Council Theatre Group presents the Cole Porter classic: romance, mistaken identities and spectacular dance numbers. Double-cast, so each night is a different show.

entries.name: Live Music @ Town Square: Stephan Vogler
entries.blurb: The fall Friday-night live music series continues with Stephan Vogler: live music and good food every Friday night.

entries.name: ORE & ORCAS: Howe Sound, a Recovering Ecosystem
entries.blurb: New exhibit on Howe Sound’s recovering ecosystem, alongside the underground mine tour, gold panning and the BOOM! show.

entries.name: Cornucopia Drink Seminar: Free Spirit Whistler!
entries.blurb: An alcohol-free tasting seminar as part of Cornucopia’s closing weekend.

entries.name: Cornucopia Drink Seminar: Italy Beyond Pinot Grigio
entries.blurb: A Cornucopia drink seminar exploring Italian wines beyond Pinot Grigio.

entries.name: Early-season Nordic ski at Whistler Olympic Park
entries.blurb: First Nordic laps of the season on snow stored from last year, plus the grand opening of the Nordic Ski Shop on Saturday.

sources.label: whistler.com: The Local’s List: What’s On in November

warnings: Hours not listed on the source page

entries.name: Surf Hat @ Après Après
entries.blurb: The Squamish psych-surf duo bring their fall tour to Whistler: reverb-soaked guitars, catchy hooks and electrifying live shows.

entries.name: Cornucopia 30th Edition Gala
entries.blurb: Cornucopia’s ultimate 30th birthday celebration: a Greek-inspired, party-forward gala with wines, sparkling pours, cocktails, spirits, creative alcohol-free options and delicious bites.

entries.name: SORCA Dig Day #11: Corsa Cycles
entries.venue: Kiki, meet at the end of Tantalus Rd, Squamish
entries.blurb: Trail-building morning hosted by Corsa Cycles. Give back to the network as the autumn air gets crisp.

entries.name: Squamish Farmers Winter Market
entries.blurb: The winter market with local produce, food and artisans in downtown Squamish.

entries.name: Maiden Vancouver
entries.venue: Brackendale Art Gallery, 41950 Government Rd, Squamish
entries.blurb: Live music night at the Brackendale Art Gallery café and culture centre.

entries.name: Country Night: Judah Wardrope
entries.blurb: Modern and classic country hits all night long with Judah Wardrope and his band.

entries.name: Signal Hill Fall Fair
entries.blurb: Family-friendly fall fair supporting the Signal Hill PAC: games and challenges, face painting, prizes, snacks and hot drinks, a gift basket raffle, snow cones and hair glitter.

entries.name: Anything Goes: The Musical
entries.blurb: Second night of the Pemberton Arts Council Theatre Group’s Cole Porter musical. A different cast from Friday, so a completely different show.
warnings: Show time not listed on the source pages

entries.name: Mark Crissinger Blues Band
entries.venue: Lions Bay Village Hall, 400 Centre Rd
entries.blurb: Veteran blues-rocker and former Toronto scene mainstay Mark Crissinger brings his high-energy, original blues sound to Lions Bay for a full-band performance, with a new album in tow.

sources.label: eventbrite.ca: Mark Crissinger Blues Band in Lions Bay

entries.name: The Brunch League: Cornucopia closing event
entries.blurb: Cornucopia wraps with a karaoke brunch: weekend brunch meets your favourite singalong, with brunch bites, music, singing and dancing.

entries.name: Nathan Stanley: A Tribute to Dr. Ralph Stanley
entries.blurb: Dove Award winner and Grammy nominee Nathan Stanley celebrates the life, legacy and timeless music of his grandfather, bluegrass pioneer Dr. Ralph Stanley.

notes: Confirm before you go. Times were researched on Nov 11, 2026 from the source pages linked above. Check the event pages directly before heading out, especially listings marked with time warnings.

Events without stated times were listed on their source calendars with no start time given; the Whistler Farmers’ Market season ended Oct 11, so it is not running this weekend. No events were found for Horseshoe Bay or Furry Creek this weekend.
